recruiting.vacancyEmptyText: The funnel starts with a vacancy: every candidate belongs to exactly one opening.

vacancyAction.closeText: The vacancy closes: no new candidates can be added and it disappears from the vacancy picker. Existing candidates, their stages and offers stay untouched. You can reopen it whenever you need to.
vacancyAction.reopenText: The vacancy becomes open again and can accept candidates. Its closing date is cleared.
vacancyAction.deleteText: The record is removed from the list (kept in the database). Use this ONLY for a record created by mistake — a typo, a test vacancy. A vacancy that already has candidates cannot be deleted: it is history and should be closed instead.

recruiting.candidateNotePlaceholder: Internal note: who referred them, what stands out
recruiting.candidateEmptyText: Add a candidate manually, or wait for the Telegram application bot.
recruiting.candidateNotFoundText: Try changing the search or the filters.

candidateAction.rejectText: The COMPANY’s decision: the candidate leaves the funnel. The record is kept — you may revisit it in a future search.
candidateAction.withdrawText: The CANDIDATE’s decision: they walked away. This is deliberately separate from “we rejected” — in funnel reports they mean very different things.
candidateAction.reassignText: The candidate stays in the funnel, only the opening changes. The stage history is preserved.
candidateAction.deleteText: The record is removed from the list (kept in the database). Use this ONLY for a record created by mistake: a rejected candidate is kept — they are the base for a future search.

recruiting.startStageHint: Leave empty and the candidate starts at the beginning of the funnel
recruiting.funnelNoStagesText: At least one active stage is required to draw the funnel. Configure them in “Reference data → Pipeline stages”.
recruiting.stagesEmptyText: Every interview, panel and phone call is recorded in this timeline.
recruiting.resumeDeleteText: The file is removed from both the database and the disk. This cannot be undone.
recruiting.offerSalaryHint: This exact amount goes into the hiring order
recruiting.offerStartDateHint: Leave empty — the date the offer was sent
recruiting.offerNotePlaceholder: Negotiation details — not shown to the candidate
recruiting.offersEmptyText: The offer is the final formal step of the funnel: once accepted, the candidate becomes an employee.
recruiting.offerPendingHint: There is an offer awaiting a response — record its answer first, then send a new one.

offerClose.declineText: The offer closes, but the candidate STAYS in the funnel: a decline is not the end of the negotiation — you can send a second offer on new terms.
offerClose.expireText: No answer arrived. The offer closes and the candidate stays in the funnel.

recruiting.acceptEffectEmployee: The candidate becomes an EMPLOYEE and their card appears in the Employees list.
recruiting.acceptEffectProbation: A probation period starts — they appear in the Probation list.
